8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.title: ACC 516 - Research Methods and Ethics
8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.content: Research methods is concerned with solving problems, investigating relationships and building a body of knowledge. The course provides the research process, by focusing on actual choices made in the conduct of research projects, together with a realistic perception. It also helps students to publish their findings in the related field using their knowledge of research tools and methods. The goal of the unit may be summarized as an understanding of contemporary research ideas, an awareness of alternative research methods and an appreciation of the ethical constraints of research. The course begins with an overview of theory and research concepts, developing the hypotheses, data collection and analysis, experimental research, survey research, fieldwork, archival research and turning research into publications.

9dcff365-0364-4c31-bfa4-746ad6301c53.title: ACC 516 - Araştırma Yöntemleri ve Etik
9dcff365-0364-4c31-bfa4-746ad6301c53.content: Araştırma yöntemleri problem çözme, ilişkileri inceleme ve bilgiden inşa edilmiş bir gövde oluşturmakla ilgilenir. Bu ders, gerçekçi bir algıyla birlikte, araştırma projelerinin yürütülmesinde yapılan gerçek tercihlere odaklanarak araştırma sürecini inceler. Ayrıca öğrencilerin, araştırma araç ve yöntem bilgilerini kullanarak ilgili alanda buldukları sonuçları yayınlamalarına yardım eder. Dersin amacı, modern araştırma fikirlerinin anlaşılması, alternatif araştırma yöntemleri ile ilgili farkındalık uyandırma ve araştırmanın etik sınırlarının değerlendirilmesi olarak özetlenebilir. Ders teoriye genel bir bakış ve araştırma kavramları ile başlar ve hipotez geliştirme, veri toplama ve analizi, deneysel araştırma, anket araştırması, saha çalışması, arşivsel araştırma ve araştırmayı yayına dönüştürme ile devam eder.

2e25d4f4-25fe-45a1-a77e-7b90e18d4709.title: PTR 516 - Kanıta Dayalı Kardiyopulmoner Rehabilitasyon
2e25d4f4-25fe-45a1-a77e-7b90e18d4709.content: Bu derste, yaygın kardiyovasküler ve solunum hastalıklarının patofizyolojisi, risk faktörleri, klinik belirtileri, prognozları, değerlendirmeleri, tedavileri ve fizyoterapi ve rehabilitasyon yaklaşımlarını kanıta dayalı biçimde incelemektedir. Kardiyopulmoner hastalıklardan ve risk faktörlerinden korunma yöntemleri ve eğitimi, toplum sağlığı ve kronik hastalıkların yönetiminde biyopsikososyal süreçler açıklanmaktadır. Kardiyopulmoner sistemin ve rehabilitasyon uygulamalarının değerlendirilmesi literatür bilgileri ışığında tartışılır.

3ba776c9-45fe-4e65-b7a8-8783a78b3521.title: PTR 516 - Evidence-Based Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation
3ba776c9-45fe-4e65-b7a8-8783a78b3521.content: This course covers the pathophysiology, risk factors, clinical manifestations, prognoses, assessments, treatments, and physiotherapy and rehabilitation approaches of common cardiovascular and respiratory diseases in an evidence-based manner. Methods and education of prevention from cardiopulmonary diseases and risk factors, biopsychosocial processes in the management of public health and chronic diseases are explained. Evaluation of the cardiopulmonary system and rehabilitation practices is discussed in the light of the literature.

df2539af-6bfd-47ed-918f-7a78d13dc424.title: PSY 516 - Ergenlik
df2539af-6bfd-47ed-918f-7a78d13dc424.content: Bu ders kritik öneme sahip olan ergenlik dönemini çocukluktan yetişkinliğe giden gelişim eğrisi üzerinde ele alacaktır. Ergenlik döneminin doğası psikopatoloji açısından ele alınarak ergenlik döneminde tanı meselesi tartışılacaktır. Çocukluk dönemindeki gelişimsel psikopatoloji ve yetişkinlik dönemindeki tanı kategorilerinin ergenlik dönemindeki yansımalarından bahsedilerek, psikopatolojiye gelişimsel bir yaklaşım sunulacaktır. Ayrıca ergenlik dönemi için terapötik müdahaleler yine gelişimsel bir yaklaşım ile anlatılacak ve tartışılacaktır.

54c7a85b-319b-46d0-a3eb-13a081007623.title: EIKY 516 - Coaching and Development
54c7a85b-319b-46d0-a3eb-13a081007623.content: This innovative course examines the links between coaching and organization development through a Gestalt perspective while emphasizing a developmental perspective for students on three levels: learning and awareness about self as a coach, developing presence in group and organizational domains, creating productive and fulfilling relationships through the coaching skill, and understanding coaching within systems dynamics. Coaching is needed today more than ever as a critical tool in organizational settings in the face of chaotic contextual change. Organizations need to adapt to today's rapidly shifting marketplace, but people and systems are naturally resistant to change. Coaching can facilitate productive transformation in persons, teams and systems by enabling leader managers and employees to unleash potential that might otherwise go untapped. Through coaching, students will learn how coaching helps them clarify their visions, beliefs and needs, and enable them to fully embody their presence. In changing from old hierarchical models to relational models for leading and influencing, businesses are creating coaching cultures that encourage organizational learning. This course will provide students with the opportunity to be equipped with the necessary knowledge and practice, for coaching has emerged as the best way to help individuals learn and create supportive work environments.

7f513491-63a8-41d1-8388-3c0d38c34020.title: PSY 516 - Adolescence
7f513491-63a8-41d1-8388-3c0d38c34020.content: This course will focus on the very critical period of adolescence on the developmental trajectory from childhood to adulthood. The nature of adolescence will be inspected as to its connections to psychopathology and the issue of diagnosis in adolescence will be discussed. The reflections of the developmental psychopathology of childhood and diagnostic categories of adulthood on the period of adolescence will be mentioned and a developmental perspective on psyhcopathology will be offered. Further, the therapeutic interventions will be presented and discussed, again with a developmental perspective in mind.

b9ec4ded-fc82-4ab6-b6b0-1d3dfa0e2316.title: EIKY 516 - Koçluk ve Gelişim
b9ec4ded-fc82-4ab6-b6b0-1d3dfa0e2316.content: Bu yenilikçi ders, koçluk ve organizasyonel gelişim arasındaki ilişkileri Gestalt bakış açısından inceler. Aynı zamanda, öğrencilere gelişim açısından üç temel seviyede perspektif sunar: bir koç olarak kişisel farkındalıkla hareket etmek ve öğrenme yaklaşımını keşfetmek: grup ve organizasyonel alanlarda mevcudiyetini güçlendirmek, koçluk becerisi sayesinde üretken ve tatminkâr ilişkiler yaratmak ve koçluğu sistem dinamikleri içerisinde keşfetmek. İş ortamındaki kaotik değişimler karşısında koçluk, hayati öneme sahip organizasyonel bir araç olarak ortaya çıkıyor. Organizasyonlar hızla değişen piyasa şartlarına uyum sağlarken sistemin en önemli parçası olan insan ve sistemler değişime doğal olarak direnç gösteriyor. Koçluk, kullanılmayabilecek kaynakları devreye alarak birey, ekip ve sistemlerde yapıcı bir dönüşümü mümkün kılar. Bu derste, öğrenciler koçluğun kişisel vizyonlarını, inanç ve ihtiyaçlarını netleştirmelerine nasıl destek olacağını keşfeder ve mevcudiyetleriyle yarattıkları etkiyi benimsemelerini sağlar. Günümüzün organizasyonları ve literatür, geleneksel hiyerarşik organizasyon modellerinden ilişkisel liderlik ve etkileme modellerine geçerken, işletmeler organizasyonel öğrenmeyi destekleme adına koçluk kültürleri oluşturuyor. Bu ders, öğrencilere gerekli bilgi ve deneyim donanımını sağlama hedefi taşıyor. Zira, koçluk bireylerin öğrenmesi ve iyiliksever iş ortamlarının yaratılması için öne çıkan en önemli araç olarak değerlendiriliyor.

WTO Chairs Programme (WCP) is one of the WTO's ﬂagship products that also provides some ﬁnancial support to beneﬁciary institutions for a period of four years. It facilitates continuous interaction between these institutions and other think-tanks and academic institutions across the world. The WTO wants to promote research on WTO-related issues among young scholars, and to reinforce the relationship between the WTO and the academic community both at the national and regional level. Through İstanbul Bilgi University’s analytical input into the formulation and implementation of trade policy, the Chair will contribute to enhancing the participation of Türkiye into the international trading environment. 9dcff365-0364-4c31-bfa4-746ad6301c53.title: ACC 516 - Araştırma Yöntemleri ve Etik
9dcff365-0364-4c31-bfa4-746ad6301c53.content: Araştırma yöntemleri problem çözme, ilişkileri inceleme ve bilgiden inşa edilmiş bir gövde oluşturmakla ilgilenir. Bu ders, gerçekçi bir algıyla birlikte, araştırma projelerinin yürütülmesinde yapılan gerçek tercihlere odaklanarak araştırma sürecini inceler. Ayrıca öğrencilerin, araştırma araç ve yöntem bilgilerini kullanarak ilgili alanda buldukları sonuçları yayınlamalarına yardım eder. Dersin amacı, modern araştırma fikirlerinin anlaşılması, alternatif araştırma yöntemleri ile ilgili farkındalık uyandırma ve araştırmanın etik sınırlarının değerlendirilmesi olarak özetlenebilir. Ders teoriye genel bir bakış ve araştırma kavramları ile başlar ve hipotez geliştirme, veri toplama ve analizi, deneysel araştırma, anket araştırması, saha çalışması, arşivsel araştırma ve araştırmayı yayına dönüştürme ile devam eder.

8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.title: ACC 516 - Research Methods and Ethics
8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.content: Research methods is concerned with solving problems, investigating relationships and building a body of knowledge. The course provides the research process, by focusing on actual choices made in the conduct of research projects, together with a realistic perception. It also helps students to publish their findings in the related field using their knowledge of research tools and methods. The goal of the unit may be summarized as an understanding of contemporary research ideas, an awareness of alternative research methods and an appreciation of the ethical constraints of research. The course begins with an overview of theory and research concepts, developing the hypotheses, data collection and analysis, experimental research, survey research, fieldwork, archival research and turning research into publications.

The course ACC 516 is primarily theoretical, as indicated by its **THEORYPRACTICE_HOUR** attribute, which is **3+0**. This means that the course consists of 3 hours of theoretical instruction with no practical hours.

8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.title: ACC 516 - Research Methods and Ethics
8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.content: Research methods is concerned with solving problems, investigating relationships and building a body of knowledge. The course provides the research process, by focusing on actual choices made in the conduct of research projects, together with a realistic perception. It also helps students to publish their findings in the related field using their knowledge of research tools and methods. The goal of the unit may be summarized as an understanding of contemporary research ideas, an awareness of alternative research methods and an appreciation of the ethical constraints of research. The course begins with an overview of theory and research concepts, developing the hypotheses, data collection and analysis, experimental research, survey research, fieldwork, archival research and turning research into publications.

9dcff365-0364-4c31-bfa4-746ad6301c53.title: ACC 516 - Araştırma Yöntemleri ve Etik
9dcff365-0364-4c31-bfa4-746ad6301c53.content: Araştırma yöntemleri problem çözme, ilişkileri inceleme ve bilgiden inşa edilmiş bir gövde oluşturmakla ilgilenir. Bu ders, gerçekçi bir algıyla birlikte, araştırma projelerinin yürütülmesinde yapılan gerçek tercihlere odaklanarak araştırma sürecini inceler. Ayrıca öğrencilerin, araştırma araç ve yöntem bilgilerini kullanarak ilgili alanda buldukları sonuçları yayınlamalarına yardım eder. Dersin amacı, modern araştırma fikirlerinin anlaşılması, alternatif araştırma yöntemleri ile ilgili farkındalık uyandırma ve araştırmanın etik sınırlarının değerlendirilmesi olarak özetlenebilir. Ders teoriye genel bir bakış ve araştırma kavramları ile başlar ve hipotez geliştirme, veri toplama ve analizi, deneysel araştırma, anket araştırması, saha çalışması, arşivsel araştırma ve araştırmayı yayına dönüştürme ile devam eder.

7f513491-63a8-41d1-8388-3c0d38c34020.title: PSY 516 - Adolescence
7f513491-63a8-41d1-8388-3c0d38c34020.content: This course will focus on the very critical period of adolescence on the developmental trajectory from childhood to adulthood. The nature of adolescence will be inspected as to its connections to psychopathology and the issue of diagnosis in adolescence will be discussed. The reflections of the developmental psychopathology of childhood and diagnostic categories of adulthood on the period of adolescence will be mentioned and a developmental perspective on psyhcopathology will be offered. Further, the therapeutic interventions will be presented and discussed, again with a developmental perspective in mind.

26bb4c8d-1dd1-405a-b569-f383ab26dd61.title: ACC 520 - Yüksek Lisans Projesi
26bb4c8d-1dd1-405a-b569-f383ab26dd61.content: Bir öğretim üyesi danışmanlığında gerçekleştirilecek bitirme projesinin amacı öğrencinin program boyunca edinmiş olduğu bilgi ve becerileri uygulamada veya bir konunun derinlemesine araştırmasında kullanarak geliştirmesidir.

0ed042cd-e87b-4e16-b850-b2598c0f3b75.title: ACC 600 - Yüksek Lisans Tezi I
0ed042cd-e87b-4e16-b850-b2598c0f3b75.content: Tezli Yüksek Lisans Programı'nda yazılması beklenilen tez, bilimsel kriterlere uygun kaleme alınmış, araştırma ürünü, özgün bir çalışma olmalıdır. Öğrencinin bu çalışmayla, edindiği bilgileri değerlendirme ve yorumlama yeteneğini kazanmış olduğunu kanıtlaması beklenir.

54c7a85b-319b-46d0-a3eb-13a081007623.title: EIKY 516 - Coaching and Development
54c7a85b-319b-46d0-a3eb-13a081007623.content: This innovative course examines the links between coaching and organization development through a Gestalt perspective while emphasizing a developmental perspective for students on three levels: learning and awareness about self as a coach, developing presence in group and organizational domains, creating productive and fulfilling relationships through the coaching skill, and understanding coaching within systems dynamics. Coaching is needed today more than ever as a critical tool in organizational settings in the face of chaotic contextual change. Organizations need to adapt to today's rapidly shifting marketplace, but people and systems are naturally resistant to change. Coaching can facilitate productive transformation in persons, teams and systems by enabling leader managers and employees to unleash potential that might otherwise go untapped. Through coaching, students will learn how coaching helps them clarify their visions, beliefs and needs, and enable them to fully embody their presence. In changing from old hierarchical models to relational models for leading and influencing, businesses are creating coaching cultures that encourage organizational learning. This course will provide students with the opportunity to be equipped with the necessary knowledge and practice, for coaching has emerged as the best way to help individuals learn and create supportive work environments.

c2c5238a-69f7-40c6-8cc3-3304ccd415ec.title: ACC 520 - MSc Project
c2c5238a-69f7-40c6-8cc3-3304ccd415ec.content: The graduation project, which is supervised by a faculty member, requires the student to put the knowledge and skills acquired through his course work into applied use or to do an indepth research of a particular topic.

3ba776c9-45fe-4e65-b7a8-8783a78b3521.title: PTR 516 - Evidence-Based Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation
3ba776c9-45fe-4e65-b7a8-8783a78b3521.content: This course covers the pathophysiology, risk factors, clinical manifestations, prognoses, assessments, treatments, and physiotherapy and rehabilitation approaches of common cardiovascular and respiratory diseases in an evidence-based manner. Methods and education of prevention from cardiopulmonary diseases and risk factors, biopsychosocial processes in the management of public health and chronic diseases are explained. Evaluation of the cardiopulmonary system and rehabilitation practices is discussed in the light of the literature.

8c1f8ece-60d8-41b1-9a79-8b25d896ead8.title: ACC 601 - MSc Thesis II
8c1f8ece-60d8-41b1-9a79-8b25d896ead8.content: The thesis, which is required for successful completion of this graduate program, is expected to be an original study that is a product of intensive research and prepared in compliance with academic criteria.

f82d53e4-e657-4131-8fdc-6fddc62ae2f1.title: ACC 600 - MSc Thesis I
f82d53e4-e657-4131-8fdc-6fddc62ae2f1.content: The thesis, which is required for successful completion of this graduate program, is expected to be an original study that is a product of intensive research and prepared in compliance with academic criteria.

df2539af-6bfd-47ed-918f-7a78d13dc424.title: PSY 516 - Ergenlik
df2539af-6bfd-47ed-918f-7a78d13dc424.content: Bu ders kritik öneme sahip olan ergenlik dönemini çocukluktan yetişkinliğe giden gelişim eğrisi üzerinde ele alacaktır. Ergenlik döneminin doğası psikopatoloji açısından ele alınarak ergenlik döneminde tanı meselesi tartışılacaktır. Çocukluk dönemindeki gelişimsel psikopatoloji ve yetişkinlik dönemindeki tanı kategorilerinin ergenlik dönemindeki yansımalarından bahsedilerek, psikopatolojiye gelişimsel bir yaklaşım sunulacaktır. Ayrıca ergenlik dönemi için terapötik müdahaleler yine gelişimsel bir yaklaşım ile anlatılacak ve tartışılacaktır.

1e848550-9ae7-4557-9417-1b1b319d8a7f.title: ACC 601 - Yüksek Lisans Tezi II
1e848550-9ae7-4557-9417-1b1b319d8a7f.content: Tezli Yüksek Lisans Programı'nda yazılması beklenilen tez, bilimsel kriterlere uygun kaleme alınmış, araştırma ürünü, özgün bir çalışma olmalıdır. Öğrencinin bu çalışmayla, edindiği bilgileri değerlendirme ve yorumlama yeteneğini kazanmış olduğunu kanıtlaması beklenir.

2e25d4f4-25fe-45a1-a77e-7b90e18d4709.title: PTR 516 - Kanıta Dayalı Kardiyopulmoner Rehabilitasyon
2e25d4f4-25fe-45a1-a77e-7b90e18d4709.content: Bu derste, yaygın kardiyovasküler ve solunum hastalıklarının patofizyolojisi, risk faktörleri, klinik belirtileri, prognozları, değerlendirmeleri, tedavileri ve fizyoterapi ve rehabilitasyon yaklaşımlarını kanıta dayalı biçimde incelemektedir. Kardiyopulmoner hastalıklardan ve risk faktörlerinden korunma yöntemleri ve eğitimi, toplum sağlığı ve kronik hastalıkların yönetiminde biyopsikososyal süreçler açıklanmaktadır. Kardiyopulmoner sistemin ve rehabilitasyon uygulamalarının değerlendirilmesi literatür bilgileri ışığında tartışılır.

b9ec4ded-fc82-4ab6-b6b0-1d3dfa0e2316.title: EIKY 516 - Koçluk ve Gelişim
b9ec4ded-fc82-4ab6-b6b0-1d3dfa0e2316.content: Bu yenilikçi ders, koçluk ve organizasyonel gelişim arasındaki ilişkileri Gestalt bakış açısından inceler. Aynı zamanda, öğrencilere gelişim açısından üç temel seviyede perspektif sunar: bir koç olarak kişisel farkındalıkla hareket etmek ve öğrenme yaklaşımını keşfetmek: grup ve organizasyonel alanlarda mevcudiyetini güçlendirmek, koçluk becerisi sayesinde üretken ve tatminkâr ilişkiler yaratmak ve koçluğu sistem dinamikleri içerisinde keşfetmek. İş ortamındaki kaotik değişimler karşısında koçluk, hayati öneme sahip organizasyonel bir araç olarak ortaya çıkıyor. Organizasyonlar hızla değişen piyasa şartlarına uyum sağlarken sistemin en önemli parçası olan insan ve sistemler değişime doğal olarak direnç gösteriyor. Koçluk, kullanılmayabilecek kaynakları devreye alarak birey, ekip ve sistemlerde yapıcı bir dönüşümü mümkün kılar. Bu derste, öğrenciler koçluğun kişisel vizyonlarını, inanç ve ihtiyaçlarını netleştirmelerine nasıl destek olacağını keşfeder ve mevcudiyetleriyle yarattıkları etkiyi benimsemelerini sağlar. Günümüzün organizasyonları ve literatür, geleneksel hiyerarşik organizasyon modellerinden ilişkisel liderlik ve etkileme modellerine geçerken, işletmeler organizasyonel öğrenmeyi destekleme adına koçluk kültürleri oluşturuyor. Bu ders, öğrencilere gerekli bilgi ve deneyim donanımını sağlama hedefi taşıyor. Zira, koçluk bireylerin öğrenmesi ve iyiliksever iş ortamlarının yaratılması için öne çıkan en önemli araç olarak değerlendiriliyor.

17f36d78-0683-448c-ba69-cc1dd2116547.title: EEEN 205 - Uygulamalı Devreler
17f36d78-0683-448c-ba69-cc1dd2116547.content: The objective of this course is to provide students with hands-on experience in designing, analyzing, and testing both electrical (analog) and digital circuits. Through a series of structured experiments, students will reinforce theoretical concepts, develop practical circuit-building skills, and gain proficiency in using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, function generators, and digital logic analyzers. By the end of the course, students will be able to confidently apply circuit theory to real-world systems and bridge the gap between simulation and hardware implementation.

### Ön Koşul Bilgisi
YZG 411 - Advanced Topics in Software Development dersi için ön koşul bulunmamaktadır. 

Bununla birlikte, verilen-context'te YZG 411 dersinin ayrıntıları sunulmaktadır ancak burada açıkça bir ön koşul belirtilmemektedir. Eğer dersle ilgili daha详细 bilgiye ihtiyacınız varsa, **Department of Software Development** ile temas kurmanız önerilir.

5006f655-f6b4-4d82-a9fc-0a89d6b8e465.title: IR 411 - Dissertation I
5006f655-f6b4-4d82-a9fc-0a89d6b8e465.content: This is a thesis writing course. The course coordinator is Hasret Dikici Bilgin. However, the student is required to determine a topic in a field of interest, to meet with a department member from the appropriate field of study, and to inform Hasret Dikici Bilgin after receiving the approval of the department member. After receiving the e-mail of the lecturer who agrees to be an advisor, consent to the course will be given and the student will take the course in that way. In the program, the course is placed, but not taught separately. The student and his/her advisor will conduct the course in the way they determine. Students who take IR 411 must take IR 412 in the following semester. Students in the graduation stage (last term) cannot take IR 411.

9c148ab7-4f96-47ba-9cc6-a404f50d10dc.title: MED 411 - Global Communication
9c148ab7-4f96-47ba-9cc6-a404f50d10dc.content: MED 411 is designed to enlarge your vision of media debates, concepts, and issues on a global level. This course examines how communication operates across national, cultural, political, economic, and technological boundaries. MED 411 will encompass many subjects related to global politics and how the media plays a crucial part in this highly complicated world. The successful completion of this course should serve as helpful preparation for the MA degree in global media and international relations.

d866e891-a9a5-4f8e-a642-8515a6ede4d0.title: MED 411 - Küresel İletişim
d866e891-a9a5-4f8e-a642-8515a6ede4d0.content: MED 411, küresel düzeyde medya tartışmaları, kavramları ve sorunlarına dair vizyonunuzu genişletmek için tasarlanmıştır. Bu ders, iletişimin ulusal, kültürel, politik, ekonomik ve teknolojik sınırlar arasında nasıl işlediğini inceler. MED 411, küresel politika ve medyanın bu son derece karmaşık dünyada nasıl önemli bir rol oynadığıyla ilgili birçok konuyu kapsayacaktır. Bu dersin başarıyla tamamlanması, küresel medya ve uluslararası ilişkiler alanında yüksek lisans derecesine yönelik faydalı bir hazırlık sağlayacaktır.

c79899bd-a84b-4afa-88f2-363879139924.title: IR 411 - Bitirme Tezi I
c79899bd-a84b-4afa-88f2-363879139924.content: Bu bir tez yazım dersidir. Ders koordinatörü Hasret Dikici Bilgin'dir. Ancak öğrencinin ilgilendiği bir alanda bir konu belirlemesi, konuya uygun çalışma alanından bir bölüm hocasıyla görüşmesi, hocanın onayını aldıktan sonra Hasret Dikici Bilgin'e haber vermesi gerekmektedir. Danışmanlık yapmayı kabul eden hocanın epostası ulaştıktan sonra derse rıza verilecek, öğrenci dersi o şekilde alacaktır. Programda ders yerleştirilmektedir, ama ayrıca ders işlenmemektedir. Öğrenci ile danışmanı dersi kendi belirledikleri şekilde yürütecektir. IR 411 dersini alan öğrencinin IR 412 dersini bir sonraki dönem alması zorunludur. Mezuniyet aşamasındaki öğrenciler IR 411 dersini alamazlar.

c46b887f-5691-4dbb-9703-ef39f17ca33e.title: ARCH 411 - Principles of Conservation and Restoration
c46b887f-5691-4dbb-9703-ef39f17ca33e.content: ARCH 411 Principles of Conservation and Restoration aims to enable the students to comprehend the basics of theoretical framework of field of conservation and restoration, to get acquainted with documentation and application methods and to structure their own balanced approach to conservation and design. The studio is composed of lecture and practice sections and proceeds in coherency with ARCH 401 Aechitectural Design Studio. The lectures of the studio are based on following themes: i. discussions on the basic concepts of architectural and urban conservation, ii. analysis of the cultural heritage based on various topics such as socio-economics, cultural values, function, utility, modifications and deterioration, iii. evaluation of architectural features iv. development process of architectural restoration design v. urban conservation vi. adaptive design - designing 'new' in the traditional fabric In parallel, practice sessions are organized around the production of various design materials including video technique with content on basic surveys, readings, urban analysis and a design problem. The process and products will be utilized in ARCH 401 Architectural Design Studio as design input for adaptive reuse project.

28574089-b499-480a-af5a-481e3f71dacf.title: ARCH 411 - Tarihi Çevre Koruma ve Restorasyon
28574089-b499-480a-af5a-481e3f71dacf.content: ARCH 411 Tarihi Çevre Koruma ve Restorasyon Stüdyosu, koruma ve restorasyon alanının kuramsal altyapısının temellerini kavrama, belgeleme ve uygulama biçimleri konusunda bilgi sahibi olma ve koruma - tasarım ilişkisini kurabilen bir proje yaklaşımı benimseme amacıyla tasarlanmıştır. Stüdyo, ders sunumları ve uygulama seansları şeklinde 2 kısımda işlenmektedir ve ARCH 401 Mimari Tasarım Stüdyosu ile bütünlük içinde sürdürülmektedir. Stüdyonun dersleri, tarihi çevre ve koruma konularındaki temel kavramların tartışılması, kültür varlığı ve tarihi çevrenin sosyo-ekonomik, kültürel değerler, gelenekler, kullanıma dair ya da fiziksel değişiklikler ve bozulmalar açısından incelenmesi, niteliklerinin okunması ve değerlendirilmesi çerçevesinde kurgulanmış ve örnek sunumlarıyla desteklenmektedir. Stüdyonun uygulama kısmı ise, teorik ders sunumlarının örnekler üzerinden tartışıldığı, görsel ve yazılı malzeme, temel rölöve, çevre analizleri ve koruma projesi egzersizleri ile tanımlanmıştır. Süreç ve ürünler, ARCH 401 Mimari Tasarım Stüdyosu kapsamında, yapılı çevreyi okuma ve yeniden üretime dair veriler olarak kullanılacaktır.

45cb55c8-f31f-4bb6-b0c6-371a280ea890.title: GE 411 - Sinematik Kent
45cb55c8-f31f-4bb6-b0c6-371a280ea890.content: Bu ders şehrin yaşanmış tecrübesinin film pratiğine aktarımını konu alır. Geç modernizm ve postmodernizmin olguları olarak 20. yüzyıldan 21. yüzyıla sinema ve metropolün birbirini yansıtarak gelişimine odaklanır. Yaşanmış tecrübe ne anlama gelir? Metropolü filme alırken bu kavramdan nasıl yararlanabiliriz? Dijital teknoloji şehrin sinemasal temsilini nasıl değiştirdi? Bu değişiklik İstanbul'a dair yaşanmış tecrübemize nasıl yansıyor? Ders süresinde gündeme gelecek sorulardan bazıları bunlar.

cea48b84-fd5d-48d2-a9c2-956efb571312.title: THM 411 - Strategic Management
cea48b84-fd5d-48d2-a9c2-956efb571312.content: This course will emphasize on some of the important current issues in strategic management. It will concentrate on modern approaches and enduring successful strategic practices. It is consciously designed with a global view since this orientation in many ways highlights the significant emerging trends in strategic management area. The course is intended to provide the students with a pragmatic approach that will guide the formulation and implementation of corporate, business, and functional strategies.

9ba2c1a7-4ac5-4780-a1eb-2b06cbb9e552.title: YZG 103 - Temel Programlama
9ba2c1a7-4ac5-4780-a1eb-2b06cbb9e552.content: Bu dersin amacı, birinci yıl üniversite öğrencilerine temel bilişim ve bilgisayar bilimleri kavramlarını tanıtmaktır. Ders, öğrencilere hem teorik hem de pratik düzeyde bilgi kazandırmayı hedefler ve onların bilgisayar teknolojilerini etkin bir şekilde kullanabilmelerini sağlar. Öğrenciler, ders boyunca takım çalışması ve grup uygulamalarıyla iş birliği yapmayı, birlikte problem çözmeyi ve proje geliştirmeyi öğrenirler. Ayrıca, ders kapsamında yazılım tasarımı ve fonksiyonel programlama temel prensipleri öğretilir, böylece öğrenciler kendi programlama projelerini planlayıp uygulayabilecek bilgi ve becerilere sahip olurlar. 163dd3f0-fd14-4cf4-bfc0-18e41596974d.content: The course deals with the different legal aspects of maritime commerce. As one of the oldest activities of trade, the law of carriage of goods by sea which governs such activity has always been of an international character. Although it is categorized as a branch of commercial law, maritime law includes many separate and distinctive features. 62a24b75-41af-4a90-b342-5e09a9aa99b5.title: YZG 103 - Introduction to Programming
62a24b75-41af-4a90-b342-5e09a9aa99b5.content: The purpose of this course is to introduce first-year university students to fundamental concepts in information technology and computer science. The course aims to provide students with both theoretical and practical knowledge, enabling them to use computer technologies effectively. Throughout the course, students learn to collaborate through teamwork and group exercises, solve problems together, and develop projects. Additionally, the course covers the basic principles of software design and functional programming, equipping students with the knowledge and skills needed to plan and implement their own programming projects. By offering entry-level programming content, the course seeks to give students a solid foundation in computer science and to develop the essential competencies required for their future academic studies.

b37ba506-50a4-4fdc-9695-ec740699d20d.title: YZG 105 - Analytical and Algorithmic Thinking
b37ba506-50a4-4fdc-9695-ec740699d20d.content: This course aims to transform ambiguous problems encountered in everyday life and professional contexts into step-by-step solvable forms through systematic analysis. The focus is on structuring the problem using frameworks such as IDEAL, explicitly stating the context and assumptions, defining inputs–outputs and success criteria, decomposing the problem into parts, selecting appropriate data structures, and ultimately designing a feasible algorithm. No specific programming language is required; solutions are mostly expressed using pseudocode and flowcharts. Students who wish may conduct small experiments with Blockly or Python during lab sessions. Following the sequence outlined in the weekly overview, the course covers foundations such as logical thinking, proof methods and induction, algorithmic complexity and Big-O notation, basic data structures, functions, and problem decomposition (GIOCE, MECE, testing). It then moves on to an intuitive introduction to recursion and dynamic programming, probability and reasoning under uncertainty, an introduction to artificial intelligence, and the ethical and societal implications of algorithmic systems. The term concludes with short project presentations that bring together these components of analytical and algorithmic thinking; throughout the solutions, correctness, efficiency, and testability (edge cases, counterexamples, simple test scenarios) are continually emphasized.

fce8d671-7723-403e-9162-84e5ec044357.title: YZG 106 - Logic and Discrete Mathematics
fce8d671-7723-403e-9162-84e5ec044357.content: The course covers basic mathematical definitions and their computer science and engineering applications. By the end of the course, students are supposed to be equipped with a relationship between theoretical mathematics and practical computer science and engineering. The students are expected to show active participation during the lectures and the lab hours.

bd9b0b28-1f3b-4e2d-aee0-65dec2095aa4.title: YZG 108 - Coding Culture
bd9b0b28-1f3b-4e2d-aee0-65dec2095aa4.content: Culture(s) of Code explores the cultural, social, and political dimensions of computer code and coding practices. Far from being a purely technical object, code shapes and is shaped by the societies in which it circulates. This course introduces students to the histories of programming languages and coding communities, and critically examines how code structures everyday life—from platforms, algorithms, and labor to art, resistance, and play. Through readings, screenings, and student projects, participants will gain a critical vocabulary for understanding code as a cultural artifact and practice.

6f3038d7-a8f1-41ab-9e46-6d418138d4af.title: EEEN 604 - Araştırma Metotları ve Yayın Etiği
6f3038d7-a8f1-41ab-9e46-6d418138d4af.content: Araştırma Yöntemleri ve Etik Yazma dersi, öğrencileri titiz araştırmalar yürütmek ve dürüstlükle bilimsel çalışmalar üretmek için gerekli temel becerilerle donatmak için tasarlanmış kapsamlı ve temel bir derstir. Bu ders, çok çeşitli disiplinlerde araştırma yürütmeyle ilgili metodolojiler, teknikler ve etik hususlara odaklanır. Ders boyunca öğrenciler araştırma tasarımı, veri toplama, analiz ve yorumlamanın inceliklerini keşfedeceklerdir. Araştırma sorularını nasıl formüle edeceklerini, hipotezler geliştireceklerini ve araştırmalarının doğasına göre uygun araştırma metodolojilerini nasıl seçeceklerini öğreneceklerdir. Ders, hem nicel hem de nitel araştırma yöntemlerini kapsar ve öğrencilerin bilgi üretimine yönelik farklı yaklaşımlar hakkında çok yönlü bir anlayış kazanmalarını sağlar.

033c035b-87be-4012-b4f4-6895cb501f90.content: Bu ders, halkla ilişkiler mesleği ve etik arasındaki ilişkiye odaklanmaktadır. Ders, halkla ilişkiler profesyonellerinin paydaşlara ve toplumun bütününe karşı olan etik sorumluluklarını tartışmak doğrultusunda tasarlanmıştır. 8e75672a-38ae-4a85-a75a-605cf9b8b294.content: Research methods is concerned with solving problems, investigating relationships and building a body of knowledge. query_metadata.user_query: Is attendance mandatory for English preparatory courses?

generation_phase.final_response:
## Attendance Policy for English Preparatory Courses
According to the [Assessment Criteria](https://www.bilgi.edu.tr/en/academic/english-language-programs/assessment/), attendance is mandatory for English preparatory courses. Students are expected to attend all English Preparatory Program classes regularly. 

### Key Points:
* Attendance is taken daily by instructors and accounts for 5% of the final grade for the term.
* Students are allowed 10 class hours of absence.
* For every additional 5 hours of absence, 1 point is deducted from the attendance grade.
* If a student accumulates 35 hours or more of absence within a 9-week term, the attendance grade is automatically calculated as 0 (zero).

It is essential to attend classes regularly to avoid any negative impact on the final grade. If you have any concerns or questions, you should contact the **English Preparatory Program** authorities for further guidance.

fe22e784-11f3-4eb0-8440-beaf15039694.content: /bilgi.hazirlik /bilgihazirlik Assessment Criteria Assessment Criteria Attendance (5%) Students are expected to attend all English Preparatory Program classes regularly. Attendance is taken daily by instructors and accounts for 5% of the final grade for the term. Students are allowed 10 class hours of absence. For every additional 5 hours of absence, 1 point is deducted from the attendance grade. If a student accumulates 35 hours or more of absence within a 9-week term, the attendance grade is automatically calculated as 0 (zero). Only continuous medical reports of 4 consecutive days from a state hospital (for serious illness or surgery) may be accepted to deduct hours from the attendance record. Single-day reports are not accepted. bfafdeab-7208-41e8-bd4d-b2f45cad2ceb.title: İngilizce Dil Becerileri Dersleri - İngilizce Hazırlık Programı | İstanbul Bilgi Üniversitesi
bfafdeab-7208-41e8-bd4d-b2f45cad2ceb.content: Yüksekokulu’nun zorunlu İngilizce dersleridir. EAP 105 ve EAP 106 dersleri arasında önkoşul vardır. Yani EAP 106 dersini alabilmek için EAP 105 dersinden geçmek gerekir. Bu dersler daha önce İngilizce eğitim almamış ya da çok az İngilizce eğitim görmüş Avrupa Dil Ölçüt Kriterlerine göre A1/ A1+ seviyesine getirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Öğrenciler hazırlık sınıfı okumamış ve de İngilizce geçmişleri yoktur. Dilbilgisi müfredatında temel zamanlar yer almakta ve sonraki seviyeler için gereken temel sağlanmaktadır. İngilizce’deki sesler çalışılmakta ve sözcük dağarcığı, en sık kullanılan sözcük ve kalıplara yer vermektedir. Temel dinleme, okuma, konuşma ve yazma becerileri de bu seviyede kademeli olarak öğrenilmektedir. Dersi başarıyla tamamlayan öğrenciler; Lisans Seçmeli İngilizce Dersleri Öğrencilerimize, İngilizcelerini daha da geliştirmek ve gerek akademik gerekse gelecek mesleki kariyerlerinde etkin dil kullanıcıları olabilmeleri için seçmeli İngilizce Dil Becerileri dersleri sunulmaktadır. İkinci, üçüncü ve dördüncü sınıf öğrencilerine, öğrenim gördükleri programlarla bağlantılı olarak alanlarına yönelik ELS 311 ve MEDE 279 dil destek dersleri önerilmektedir.

624cec39-2853-4c0f-8d8b-82428d5d0d42.content: Throughout the term, students complete three writing tasks, which aim to measure their ability to organize ideas, use appropriate language, and produce coherent written texts. These tasks may include descriptive, narrative, opinion-based, genre-focused, or problem–solution paragraphs. Each task is assessed based on content, organization, and language use. Students are informed about the requirements in advance. If a task is not submitted, the student receives 0 (zero) for that task. Medical reports are not accepted for make-up purposes, and no late submissions are allowed. Productive Speaking Tasks (PST) – 5% Throughout the term, students complete four speaking tasks, one of which is submitted as a video recording. These tasks aim to measure students’ ability to communicate effectively and accurately on topics covered in the curriculum. Task types may include interviews, role-plays, presentations, and discussions. Evaluation is based on fluency, accuracy, pronunciation, and interaction. Students are informed about the requirements in advance.

fd4a07a4-0b7d-4ad0-bc96-def3d168c0da.title: HIST 201 - Early Ottoman History
fd4a07a4-0b7d-4ad0-bc96-def3d168c0da.content: This course covers a time span from 1300 to1800. By doing so, it analyzes the Ottoman Empire as an early-modern polity with its specific institutions. The course starts with the controversial historiographical question of the “rise of the Ottoman Empire” on the legacy of the other cultures in Anatolia. It looks at related questions while discussing imperial consolidation; for example, the construction of Istanbul, the imperial capital, based on the legacy of Constantinople. In addition to these primary discussions, the course analyzes the provincial administration of the empire on the basis of a feudal economy, legal structure of the empire, the relationship of different religious groups with each other as well as with the imperial administration, and different administrative and reactionary techniques of dissent throughout the Empire. Finally, the course explores in detail the dynamics of social and economic transformation that took place in the 17th and 18th centuries.

query_metadata.user_query: What is the main objective of LAW 101?

generation_phase.final_response:
## Main Objective of LAW 101
The main objective of **LAW 101** is to give students a brief introduction to the legal system in Turkey based on research in the field, with a core theme of access to justice. This is stated in the course details found on the [LAW-EP 101 - Access to Justice in Turkey: Research and Policy](https://ects.bilgi.edu.tr/Course/Detail?catalog_courseId=24743892) course page. 

## Key Aspects of the Course
- The course aims to introduce students to studies on various dimensions of access to justice in Turkey.
- It covers aspects such as the quality and accessibility of legal aid, citizens' experiences with the legal system, legal needs, dispute resolution mechanisms, procedural justice, and court management.
- Students will participate in a court visit as part of the course.
- The instruction language is English, supported by Turkish materials and discussions.

For further details, please refer to the [course page](https://ects.bilgi.edu.tr/Course/Detail?catalog_courseId=24743892). If you have any administrative questions, you may want to contact the **Student Affairs** department for assistance.

fcde5674-a131-4c30-8b7b-82be661c6fa1.content: The objective of this course is to give students a brief introduction to the legal system in Turkey based on research in the field. The course will develop around the core theme of access to justice and introduce students to studies on various dimensions of access to justice in Turkey. Studies on the quality and accessibility of legal aid in Turkey, on citizens' experiences with the legal system, on legal needs, on dispute resolution mechanisms, on procedural justice, court management, etc., will be covered during the course to allow students to think upon various dimensions of access to justice. There will also be a court visit. The instruction language is English although class presentations and students presentations will also be accompanied by Turkish. the course is closed to students outside Law faculty.

In this context, the first part of this course is focused on the general rules of international procedural law, the jurisdiction of Turkish courts and the recognition and enforcement of foreign judgments. The international arbitration which has become the usual method of settlement of international disputes constitutes the second part of this course. The aim is to provide students a basic and essential knowledge of international arbitration. The concept of international arbitration and the recognition and the enforcement of foreign arbitral awards compose the main topics of this part. Finally, the main matters of the nationality law and the legal status of aliens are the subjects that will be covered at the end of the semester. In this context, the principals of the nationality law, the acquisition and the loss of Turkish nationality, the rights of entry and residence of aliens in Turkey, the right to work and the right of acquisition of immovable property and foreign investment in Turkey are the topics.

d5b3a53d-c05f-49df-9315-24b9a7723ded.title: LAW 465 - International Trade and Arbitration Law
d5b3a53d-c05f-49df-9315-24b9a7723ded.content: This course that is offered by the WTO Chair of İstanbul Bilgi University, consists of an overview of the law applicable to international economic relations, in particular in the fields of trade and commerce, and arbitration. It is designed as a comprehensive introduction to the evolving notion of international economic law in the intersection of public and private law aspects and its relationship with arbitration as an effective method to rule commercial and trade disputes. The primary aim of this course is to address, in a nutshell, questions related to when, why and how arbitration and international economic law have become intrinsically interfaced, the scope and current implementation of arbitral proceedings in different areas regulating international economic relations. The Course will be divided into two main sections. The first section will tackle the rules governing interstate trade relations and dispute settlement mechanism applicable therein. The second part will focus on the study of laws applicable to international commercial contracts and business transactions and the international commercial arbitration as a process of resolving business disputes between or among transnational parties through the use of one or more arbitrators rather than through the courts. These two main sections will be studied through a complementary examination of the rules and procedures applicable to the trade and commercial disputes regulated by International Agreements, Conventions, Treaties and different international arbitral institutions under the auspices of the WTO, UNCITRAL, ICC, PCA, ICCA, LCIA, ICSID, WIPO.

cdb9b32e-2882-4a8f-b4e4-1540008483e5.title: LAW 251 - Criminal Law-General Provisions I
cdb9b32e-2882-4a8f-b4e4-1540008483e5.content: Criminal law is mainly concerned with those violations of social order which are regulated as ”crimes” by the legislative organ and their prescribed punishments. In this course, the terms of crime and punishment will be covered and the sources and general principles of criminal law and techniques of interpretation governing criminal law will be examined. After the introduction, the general theory of crime will be analysed, whose main objective is to break down the crime into its components and analyse the theory of crime.

ecf534cc-a074-40ed-aaa8-8d6d69058d01.title: PHYS 101 - Physics I
ecf534cc-a074-40ed-aaa8-8d6d69058d01.content: This is a first course on the fundamental sequence of calculus-based physics. It mainly covers mechanics, which is about the motion of objects. Subjects covered include kinematics of motion, Newton's laws of motion, gravitation, work, energy, momentum, rotational motion and static equilibrium. In addition to the face to face lectures, online studies and laboratory sessions are part of the course.

35b6ffd8-67b0-44ab-9af3-7816ffc369ef.title: LAW 365 - Current Issues of Competition Law
35b6ffd8-67b0-44ab-9af3-7816ffc369ef.content: This course concerns contemporary topics and problems of antitrust law theory and practice. Today competition law faces with novel problems arising from the expansion of the information technology industries and digital markets. As social networks, internet-platforms and technology companies grow and expand rapidly, there is an urgent need to create a sound economic balance between promoting innovation and maintaining competition in the market place. The new concepts of digital era; big data, two sided markets and new forms of MCN clauses, have been increasingly occupying the agenda of antitrust agencies and professionals. On the other hand, the question of how to better tackle with the traditional anti-competitive behaviour such as cartelization has still remained unanswered alongside the everlasting discussion regarding the ultimate goals of antitrust policy. Accordingly, the main purpose of this course is to instruct the students on the contemporary problems surrounding today’s antitrust law practice. Nevertheless, in order to understand the underlying interests creating these problems, students will also be acquainted with the orthodox concepts and notions of antitrust laws. To this end, instructors of this course, Assoc. Prof. Kerem Cem Sanlı and Att. Şahin Ardıyok will analyze the US and the EU competition law practice in comparative perspective. The course does not have a prerequisite. It is open to all interested students. However, this course is structured as a complementary course of Competition Law course (Law 450) that is offered to third year students; therefore, a basic knowledge of competition law would be helpful. Language of the course is Turkish.

8f1e848d-8970-4396-9c8f-9e5a4ecda2f6.title: LAW 685 - Information Technology Law
8f1e848d-8970-4396-9c8f-9e5a4ecda2f6.content: Information and technology law is the youngest branch of law. The development and dissemination of technology has also had outcomes on the field of law. With this development and proliferation, international, regional and national regulations on information technologies have increased and a new field has emerged with its own unique rules regarding the roles, rights and obligations of the main actors and stakeholders operating in this field. The aim of this course is to examine sui generis rules related to the field of information and technology law and to reveal the difference from the traditional legal rules. Within the scope of the course, the specific methodology of information and technology law and the principles governing information and technology law are examined in detail. Within the scope of the course, essential issues such as regulation of the internet, cybercrimes, digital forensics, legal dimensions of cyber security, rules on the protection of personal data, electronic commerce regulations, trust services, blockchain and crypto assets, legal dimensions of artificial intelligence are examined in detail.

fa5c9120-b39a-44c3-be80-afb64e580315.title: LAW 204 - Contemporary Issues in Intellectual Property Law
fa5c9120-b39a-44c3-be80-afb64e580315.content: The goal of this course is to create a platform for students with a prior knowledge of the fundamentals of intellectual property law, to examine and discuss advanced intellectual property law issues. The course will not be taught by the lecturer. Instead, students shall conduct research on national, foreign or international contemporary court cases or academic sources and present them in the class. The main research topics are the effects of technological developments on IP law and contemporary developments in European law and other foreign laws. The course shall be conducted fully in English and student presentations shall also be carried out in English. Team work will be encouraged.

101d4013-982b-4f60-9f4a-e3961f4d50bb.title: LAW 429 - International Trade Law
101d4013-982b-4f60-9f4a-e3961f4d50bb.content: This course aims at exploring both the private law and the public law issues applicable to international trade relations. The first and public law part of the course will focus on the main treaties regulating international trade as embodied in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the World Trade Organization, as well as regional trade entities such as the European Union and the North American Free Trade Agreement. This part will examine the law applicable to tariff and non-tariff barriers, discrimination, regionalism, anti-dumping duties, countervailing duties, safeguard measures and the devices for international settlement of trade disputes. The second and private law part will deal with the key rules in international commercial transactions. To achieve this aim, the course will cover the fundamental characteristics of international sales of goods and essential contracts for the financing of trading activities, transportation of goods to their place of destination, settlement of disputes, and methods of payment in international commercial transactions.

bebbcb9c-8cad-4ba6-9534-c3df609b69c6.title: JUS 220 - Law of Legal Profession and Notary Law
bebbcb9c-8cad-4ba6-9534-c3df609b69c6.content: Students will be introduced to the practice of law and notary law. The main goal is to introduce students to general principles of practice of law and notary law, to equip them to fulfil their duties as legal assistants and paralegals in the law forms.

68b35cd7-4887-4c56-b6a7-bd04e446c683.title: LAW 418 - International Trade and Business Law
68b35cd7-4887-4c56-b6a7-bd04e446c683.content: This course aims at exploring both the private law and the public law issues applicable to international trade relations. The first and public law part of the course will focus on the main treaties regulating international trade as embodied in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the World Trade Organization, as well as regional trade entities such as the European Union and the North American Free Trade Agreement. This part will examine the law applicable to tariff and non-tariff barriers, discrimination, regionalism, anti-dumping duties, countervailing duties, safeguard measures and the devices for international settlement of trade disputes. The second and private law part will deal with the key rules in international commercial transactions. To achieve this aim, the course will cover the fundamental characteristics of international sales of goods and essential contracts for the financing of trading activities, transportation of goods to their place of destination, settlement of disputes, and methods of payment in international commercial transactions.

8c4038f8-8093-4ee4-821f-f493dd22bc44.title: LAW 441 - Criminal Procedure Law I
8c4038f8-8093-4ee4-821f-f493dd22bc44.content: Criminal procedure law is concerned with the enforcement of substantive criminal law. In this course, general and constitutional principles governing criminal procedure law, the role of human rights in criminal procedure systems, the structure of Turkish criminal courts and the main actors participating in criminal procedure law will be analyzed.

143cb3e2-2d1b-4ad0-ab95-6abccc2044cb.title: LAW 450 - Competition Law
143cb3e2-2d1b-4ad0-ab95-6abccc2044cb.content: This course considers the control of private economic power through competition law that has been in effect since the enactment of the Act on the Protection of Competition in 1994. The course basically covers the substantive provisions of the Act, which can be categorized into four parts. The first part concerns introductory provisions of the Act and the basic information regarding the concept of competition laws. The second part deals with vertical and horizontal cooperation agreements between undertakings in the market. Cartels, distribution agreements and the cooperative joint ventures will be the main subjects of this section. The third part involves the abusive and anti-competitive practices of monopolies such as discrimination, tying, monopoly and predatory pricing. The final part comprises the legal analysis of structural alliances, namely mergers, acquisitions and joint ventures in the markets. Time permitting, the course will also cover the enforcement structure of the Act. While the primary concern of the course is Turkish competition law, these subjects will be covered in a comparative perspective, examining U.S. and European competition laws. Theoretical economic assumptions about the behavior of markets will also be analyzed, given that competition rules are primarily based on economic theory.

93a0d6ae-b541-4e60-b7e7-218bab2b2218.title: LAW 513 - General Principles of Competition Law
93a0d6ae-b541-4e60-b7e7-218bab2b2218.content: This course considers the control of private economic power through competition law that has been in effect since the enactment of the Act on the Protection of Competition in 1994. The course basically covers the substantive provisions of the Act, which can be categorized into four parts. The first part concerns introductory provisions of the Act and the basic information regarding the concept of competition laws. The second part deals with vertical and horizontal cooperation agreements between undertakings in the market.
